The ranking changes when a near-exact bin competes with a protected mid-window bin. It may help by combining exact fills with preserved mid-size gaps, but may fail if the exact-fit bonus overrides useful window choices.

    return [(100 - (r - item)) if r - item <= 12 else (-(r - item) + (15 if 28 <= r - item <= 48 else 0) - (15 if 8 <= r - item <= 22 else 0)) for r in bins]
```
